# Discord Game SDK

This folder contains the x86 Windows files from Discord Game SDK 3.2.1.

- Official SDK package: <https://dl-game-sdk.discordapp.net/3.2.1/discord_game_sdk.zip>
- Discord's archived `discord-rpc` repository points users to the Game SDK.
- The plugin links `discord_game_sdk.dll.lib`, includes `discord_game_sdk.h`, and ships `discord_game_sdk.dll` beside the build output.

The SDK is legacy software and is no longer maintained. It is used here because it provides an x86 build for the 32-bit game process.
